verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents dispute and chargeback liability only for its general Checkout product: Crossmint takes on the risk, manages disputes with the bank, and uses authorization holds. The docs explicitly do not extend this to agent checkouts. For agent cards, the docs cover fraud-limiting controls (scoped allowances enforced via Visa VIC/Mastercard Agent Pay, merchant locking, one-time credentials) but never say who bears liability or chargebacks. Missing for 10: explicit liability and chargeback allocation for agent-initiated transactions (agent cards, agent checkouts, x402/MPP), merchant-facing dispute rules for agent purchases, and independent corroboration.
